## Versions and host
OS, Bun, Codex CLI/Desktop, tunnel-client, repository commit.

## Expected and actual behavior
Describe the failed operation and whether the native host was connected.

## Sanitized reproduction
Use a disposable workspace. Do not paste credentials, real private paths, live session IDs, browser cookies, or full logs.

## Verification
Does the issue reproduce in the native host directly? Did the tool time out, fail, or report an unknown outcome? Do not automatically repeat consequential operations.
